## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the feature ID, issue, or plan.

## Validation

List checks actually run and results. Include synthetic screenshots for UI changes.
State unverified cases and remaining limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and relevant documentation match the implementation.
- [ ] Applicable undo/save/cancel/error cases were checked (or explained as not applicable).
- [ ] Relevant accessibility and privacy requirements were checked.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, generated build output, or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] Feature status and changelog are updated where appropriate.
